title: Schools Microsoft Enterprise Licensing Agreement
description:
Newcastle City Council (NCC) is seeking the renewal of its current Microsoft Licencing Agreement for schools. NCC is seeking a new agreement with a single vendor to replace the existing expiring agreement.
Further competition will run via the CCS framework RM6068 Lot 3, via the OPEN tendering portal.

title: Ireland – Transport services (excl. Waste transport) – Invitation to Tender for Transport Provision and Taxi Service
description: Empower is currently seeking tender submissions for transport provision and taxi services, which will facilitate engagement of service users across Fingal, through the delivery of training supports and social activities, and meaningful work experience opportunities. The overall outcome of training supports will provide these individuals with increased confidence; a firm sense of direction; industry specific certification; improved job-seeking skills, which will increase the likelihood of being placed in employment and retaining such placement. Participation in social, cultural and economic activities will improve wellbeing and quality of life
